description: This Java class 'CborJsonifiableSerializer' provides serialization and deserialization of Jsonifiables using CBOR format in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It loads a CborFactory via ServiceLoader, checks its availability, and offers methods to serialize JsonObjects into ByteBuffers and deserialize ByteBuffers back into JsonValues.

classes.name: CborJsonifiableSerializer
classes.description: A final class that handles serialization of Jsonifiables into CBOR format and deserialization back to JsonValue objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: CborJsonifiableSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with an ExtendedActorSystem, and loads a CborFactory implementation via ServiceLoader, ensuring CBOR is available.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonObject into a ByteBuffer using the CborFactory.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Deserializes data from a ByteBuffer into a JsonValue using the CborFactory.
